review_candidates.title: Head of Engineering, Sales & Marketing Tools
review_candidates.description: Who we are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About The Role Sales and Marketing Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support. A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role. Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required. Who You Are You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases. 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it. At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team. You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone. You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale. You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot. You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members. Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage. A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required. Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement. Cultural Alignment As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation. Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets. Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality. Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality. Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early. Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders. No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes. Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not. Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable. What Success Looks Like In The Role Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance. Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale. A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets. Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable. A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers. Why Join Us Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid. A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through. Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond. What To Expect In The Hiring Process 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers. 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes. 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business. 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager). Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

review_candidates.title: Head of Asset Delivery
review_candidates.description: About us Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is a fully owned subsidiary of Hapag-Lloyd. Operating from Rotterdam, HGT manages a portfolio of stakes in 21 terminals and complementary logistics services across 11 countries across 5 continents: Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Africa - with plans to expand its stakes to over ~30 terminals by 2030. At HGT, we are a highly motivated team of experienced international professionals who believe that growth in any partnership comes from trust and dedication. Our commitment to provide highly efficient terminal operations that are safe, sustainable, and reliable is rooted in a simple yet powerful vision: “offering exceptional service quality at all times.” At APM Terminals, a global leader in port and terminal operations, we enable global trade and drive sustainable growth. What drives us forward is a mindset of always improving — observing how work happens, identifying what creates value, and removing what gets in the way. We constantly look for smarter, simpler, and safer ways of operating. If you thrive in environments where people value learning and are committed to continuously improve daily operations, join us and be a part of our journey. The project The Sunset Consortium, made up of Hanseatic Global Terminals and APM Terminals, is leading the development and modernization of Puerto Caldera, the main port complex on Costa Rica's Pacific coast. Having won the public tender, the consortium will carry out an investment plan of around 500 million dollars, which includes major infrastructure works and the acquisition of new state-of-the-art equipment. Operations are expected to begin in September 2027, providing a modern and competitive solution along Costa Rica's Pacific coast. The position The Head of Asset Delivery will lead the end-to-end delivery of all physical assets for the development and modernisation of Puerto Caldera: civil works, quay and yard, cargo-handling equipment, and IT/OT systems. Because this is a brownfield project, the role must make sure new works and equipment are integrated safely with the existing infrastructure, and that port operations continue throughout execution with as little disruption as possible. The Head of Asset Delivery makes sure every asset is built, tested and handed over to Operations and Maintenance safely, on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards, ready for the start of operations planned for September 2027. This is a senior technical leadership role. It directs the Quay, Yard, Civil, Equipment, IT/OT & Systems, and Integration & Testing teams, and manages contractors, suppliers and consultants. The role is site-based at Puerto Caldera, Costa Rica. It reports to the Project Director. Key Responsibilities Project Management & Business Leadership Deliver asset workstreams and produce project plans that comply with the organization's project management framework. Create reports and presentations with key information, commentary, and recommendations to support project reviews and enable stakeholders to evaluate progress and agree on changes. Identify and evaluate risks, issues, opportunities, dependencies, and constraints associated with the project, and empower your team to implement action plans in response. Track budgets and report variances to the broader team, in coordination with the Project Controls Manager, and manage the project close-out to ensure effective transition from the project environment to business as usual while capturing lessons learned. People – Leadership & Supervision Create clarity and common understanding of project goals, communicate and coordinate actions needed to implement the function's strategy and business plan within the team, and motivate people to commit to these goals. Manage and report on the performance of a diverse team, set appropriate performance objectives, and provide coaching to develop skills. Supply Chain Management & Procurement Achieve specific procurement goals, including civil works, large-scale equipment packages, IT and Automation packages, and consultancy services. Coordinate activities of subcontractors and suppliers and act as a primary point of contact for them while working within an established contract management plan. Governance & Policy Management Monitor and review performance against HSSE KPIs, take action to improve performance and resolve non-compliance with the organization's HSSE policies, procedures, and mandatory instructions.
